  <div class="hero-copy">
    <p>My research focuses on Buddhist art, monuments, and practices in East Asia. It takes an interdisciplinary approach that brings together art history, the study of texts and material sources, and the analysis of the circulation and transmission of images, forms, and practices.</p>
    <p>This site presents my current and past research, my fieldwork, and a selection of data collected over the course of my investigations. I also share my forthcoming research projects and several databases that I have developed as part of my work, in order to make them easier to consult.</p>
